title: Engineering Harness Adversarial Finding
description: One finding per file at .harness/findings/FND-nnn.yaml - the single source of truth across the whole lifecycle. LAW: every finding enters as an attack attempt (PROPOSED); confirmation authority belongs to reproduction / quality gate / human, never the reviewer.

target.description: The requirement or invariant this attack attempts to violate

status.description: Lifecycle status; only adversarial-review may set PROPOSED. Transitions: PROPOSED->REPRODUCING->{CONFIRMED|REJECTED}; CONFIRMED(RED test)->FIXING->FIXED(GREEN)->VERIFIED(full regression)->CLOSED.

regression_test.description: Required once CONFIRMED (the reproduction test becomes the regression test).

red_evidence.description: reference proving the test ran RED at CONFIRMED

green_evidence.description: reference proving the same test ran GREEN at FIXED

test.description: reproduction/regression test node id; set at CONFIRMED

fix.description: commit or summary of the minimal fix; set at FIXING/FIXED

evidence.description: full-regression evidence reference; set at VERIFIED

attempts.description: log of reproduction attempts (command/test name + result)

rejection_reason.description: required when status=REJECTED: why the scenario cannot occur
